synthesis: Liberal Democrat leader Ed Davey has proposed a £17bn income tax cut linked to rejoining EU markets, aimed at attracting former Conservative voters. Simultaneously, the party has launched an internal inquiry into religious inclusion following a discrimination claim by former candidate David Campanale. Campanale is currently seeking damages of £790,000 in a civil case against the party.
